name: @wellsfargo-starui/data
description: SharedWorker-backed data services for StarGrid DataPort. Consolidates host-data (host-data-angular stays excluded from the pipeline).

scripts.build: rimraf host-data/dist host-data/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && tsc --project host-data/tsconfig.json && node host-data/scripts/buildWorker.mjs && node host-data/scripts/copy-assets.mjs
